author: Facti0n
body:
Hello, I listened to all of the feedback that I was given from the first release and made some major additions.

Additions: 

I widened the side islands by about 20 blocks. 

I used about half of the 20 blocks that it was widened by to add a tunnel system (See images).

More detail

Please let me know if I should keep the tunnel system. I think it is a good addition because it adds 2 extra lanes which allows for more flanking. 

Details:

Xml: Coming Soon.

Still going to make it 20 vs 20

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?4hvhasgpy1vvdnr

Images: http://imgur.com/a/mgYBQ
